## `pm_taxCO2eq` (the CO2 price parameter — note: there is no `pm_co2_price`, the actual cross-boundary parameter is `pm_taxCO2eq`, declared in `core/declarations.gms:38` with the comment *"co2 price calculated in 45_carbonprice module"*)

### Calculates and writes it (primary owner)
**Module `45_carbonprice`** — every realization computes and assigns `pm_taxCO2eq` according to its own pricing scheme: `none`, `NPi`, `NPi2025`, `NPi2025expo`, `NDC`, `expoLinear`, `exogenous`, `exogenousExpo`, `functionalForm`, `functionalFormRegi`, `temperatureNotToExceed`. This is the designated owner per the declaration comment.

### Also overwrite/modify it (secondary writers, downstream of 45_carbonprice)
- **`47_regipol/regiCarbonPrice`** — resets to 0 and overrides with exogenous/ETS values (`presolve.gms`, `postsolve.gms`)
- **`21_tax/on/datainput.gms`** — overwrites historical years from a reference GDX
- **`15_climate/magicc7_ar6/postsolve.gms`** — adjusts it for temperature-limit convergence (parallel logic to `45_carbonprice/temperatureNotToExceed`)
- **`81_codePerformance/on/presolve.gms`** — sets an exponential test path (diagnostic/performance-testing realization)

### Read-only consumers
- **`21_tax/on`** (`equations.gms`, `presolve.gms`, `postsolve.gms`) — uses it for bioenergy externality and tax-revenue calculations
- **`02_welfare/ineqLognormal/equations.gms`** — uses it in the tax-redistribution equation
- **`46_carbonpriceRegi/netZero/postsolve.gms`** — reads it as the base trajectory when computing the regional markup `pm_taxCO2eqRegi`
- **`80_optimization/nash/postsolve.gms`** — reads it for iteration convergence checks
- **`80_optimization/negishi/output.gms`** — reads it (via shadow price) for output/reporting
